result.instructions: Tools for ServiceMonster, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show the service schedule for tomorrow and the customers for each job."; "Which orders still have a balance due?"; "Review this customer's service history and recent notes.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ServiceMonster data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run servicemonster_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run servicemonster_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run servicemonster_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. servicemonster_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.description: Customer accounts with names, contact details and account status. GET /v1/accounts; returns one page, not all matching records.

pageIndex.description: Zero-based page index (default0); advance it to retrieve more records.

fields.description: Optional comma-separated field names to return.

wField.description: One documented field to filter, e.g. accountName or balanceDue. Requires wValue.

wValue.description: Filter value; provide together with wField.

wOperator.description: Comparison; omit for equality. 'like' matches a substring.

tools.name: servicemonster_list_scheduling
tools.title: Read the service schedule
tools.description: GET /v1/scheduling. Defaults to today through7days ahead at the vendor. Use startDate/endDate for a bounded period; dates follow the company's scheduling context. Flattened event view, optionally one route.

routeID.description: ServiceMonster record GUID, obtained from a preceding read.

tools.name: servicemonster_list_scheduleitems
tools.title: Read detailed schedule items
tools.description: GET /v1/scheduleitems. Defaults to today through7days ahead at the vendor. Use startDate/endDate for a bounded period; dates follow the company's scheduling context. Returns each event and its associated job/activity/reminder/event details.

tools.name: servicemonster_create_note
tools.title: Add a customer, order or site note
tools.description: Create a note immediately (POST /v1/notes); no preview or separate confirmation is enforced. Requires an API User permitted to create notes; Read Only cannot write. Specify accountID, orderID or siteID; orderID and siteID cannot be combined. Ask the user to review the exact record and text before calling. No scheduling or messaging is performed.

accountID.description: ServiceMonster record GUID, obtained from a preceding read.

orderID.description: ServiceMonster record GUID, obtained from a preceding read.

siteID.description: ServiceMonster record GUID, obtained from a preceding read.
